datatype err = InvalidDimension | InvalidLayerCount | TooLarge | NonFinite | InvalidConfig | ShapeMismatch | DataLengthMismatch | NotInitialized | NumericFailure | BadFileFormat | UnsupportedVersion | Overflow | OutOfMemory | IoError

datatype ('a,'e) result = Ok 'a | Err 'e

fun bind_result :: "('a,'e) result ⇒ ('a ⇒ ('b,'e) result) ⇒ ('b,'e) result" where
"bind_result (Ok x) f = f x" |
"bind_result (Err e) f = Err e"

fun map_result :: "('a ⇒ 'b) ⇒ ('a,'e) result ⇒ ('b,'e) result" where
"map_result f (Ok x) = Ok (f x)" |
"map_result f (Err e) = Err e"

type_synonym f32 = "32 word"

definition isFinite_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
"isFinite_f32 w = (let e = slice 23 w :: 8 word; m = slice 0 w :: 23 word in e ≠ 0xFF)"

definition isInf_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
"isInf_f32 w = (let e = slice 23 w :: 8 word; m = slice 0 w :: 23 word in e = 0xFF ∧ m = 0)"

definition isNaN_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
"isNaN_f32 w = (let e = slice 23 w :: 8 word; m = slice 0 w :: 23 word in e = 0xFF ∧ m ≠ 0)"

definition f32_to_real :: "f32 ⇒ real" where
"f32_to_real w = (if isFinite_f32 w then
(let s = bit w 31; e = slice 23 w :: 8 word; m = slice 0 w :: 23 word in
let sign = if s then -1 else 1; exp = (if e = 0 then 1 else uint e) - 127 in
let mant = (if e = 0 then 0 else 1) + real (uint m) / 2^23 in
sign * (2::real)^exp * mant)
else 0)"

definition real_to_f32 :: "real ⇒ f32" where
"real_to_f32 r = (if r = 0 then 0 else
(let s = r < 0; abs_r = abs r in
let exp = floor (log 2 abs_r) in
let mant = abs_r / (2::real)^exp in
let biased_exp = if exp < -126 then 0 else of_nat (nat (exp + 127)) :: 8 word in
let mantissa = round ((mant - (if exp < -126 then 0 else 1)) * 2^23) :: 23 word in
let sign_bit = if s then 1 else 0 :: 1 word in
(ucast sign_bit << 31) OR (ucast biased_exp << 23) OR ucast mantissa))"

definition clampFinite_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
"clampFinite_f32 w = (if isFinite_f32 w then w else 0)"

fun f32_add :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
"f32_add a b = (if isNaN_f32 a ∨ isNaN_f32 b then 0x7FC00000
else if isInf_f32 a ∧ isInf_f32 b ∧ (bit a 31 ≠ bit b 31) then 0x7FC00000
else if isInf_f32 a then a
else if isInf_f32 b then b
else real_to_f32 (f32_to_real a + f32_to_real b))"

fun f32_sub :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
"f32_sub a b = (if isNaN_f32 a ∨ isNaN_f32 b then 0x7FC00000
else if isInf_f32 a ∧ isInf_f32 b ∧ (bit a 31 = bit b 31) then 0x7FC00000
else if isInf_f32 a then a
else if isInf_f32 b then (if bit b 31 then 0x7F800000 else 0xFF800000)
else real_to_f32 (f32_to_real a - f32_to_real b))"

fun f32_mul :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
"f32_mul a b = (if isNaN_f32 a ∨ isNaN_f32 b then 0x7FC00000
else if (isInf_f32 a ∧ b = 0) ∨ (isInf_f32 b ∧ a = 0) then 0x7FC00000
else if isInf_f32 a then (if (bit a 31 = bit b 31) then 0x7F800000 else 0xFF800000)
else if isInf_f32 b then (if (bit a 31 = bit b 31) then 0x7F800000 else 0xFF800000)
else real_to_f32 (f32_to_real a * f32_to_real b))"

fun f32_div :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
"f32_div a b = (if isNaN_f32 a ∨ isNaN_f32 b then 0x7FC00000
else if isInf_f32 a ∧ isInf_f32 b then 0x7FC00000
else if b = 0 then (if a = 0 then 0x7FC00000 else (if (bit a 31 = bit b 31) then 0x7F800000 else 0xFF800000))
else if isInf_f32 b then (if bit b 31 then (if bit a 31 then 0 else 0x80000000) else (if bit a 31 then 0x80000000 else 0))
else real_to_f32 (f32_to_real a / f32_to_real b))"

definition exp_overflow_threshold :: real where
"exp_overflow_threshold = 88.72283905206835"

definition exp_underflow_threshold :: real where
"exp_underflow_threshold = -103.972084045410"

fun f32_exp :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
"f32_exp a = (if isNaN_f32 a then 0x7FC00000
else if isInf_f32 a then (if bit a 31 then 0 else 0x7F800000)
else let r = f32_to_real a in
if r > exp_overflow_threshold then 0x7F800000
else if r < exp_underflow_threshold then 0
else real_to_f32 (exp r))"

fun f32_clip :: "real ⇒ real ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
"f32_clip lo hi a = (if isFinite_f32 a then
let r = f32_to_real a in
if r < lo then real_to_f32 lo else if r > hi then real_to_f32 hi else a
else if isNaN_f32 a then 0x7FC00000
else a)"

record tensor_pure =
dims :: "nat list"
data :: "f32 list"

definition is2D :: "tensor_pure ⇒ bool" where
"is2D t = (length (dims t) = 2)"

definition rows :: "tensor_pure ⇒ nat" where
"rows t = (case dims t of [r,c] ⇒ r | _ ⇒ 0)"

definition cols :: "tensor_pure ⇒ nat" where
"cols t = (case dims t of [r,c] ⇒ c | _ ⇒ 0)"

definition len_ok :: "tensor_pure ⇒ bool" where
"len_ok t = (length (data t) = rows t * cols t)"

definition tensor_inv :: "tensor_pure ⇒ bool" where
"tensor_inv t = (is2D t ∧ len_ok t)"

definition idx :: "tensor_pure ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ nat" where
"idx t i j = i * cols t + j"

definition get :: "tensor_pure ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32" where
"get t i j = data t ! idx t i j"

definition set :: "tensor_pure ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 ⇒ tensor_pure" where
"set t i j v = t⦇data := list_update (data t) (idx t i j) v⦈"

definition assert2DAndLen :: "tensor_pure ⇒ (unit,err) result" where
"assert2DAndLen t =
(case dims t of
[r,c] ⇒ if length (data t) = r * c then Ok () else Err DataLengthMismatch
| _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

lemma assert2DAndLen_Ok_imp_tensor_inv:
assumes "assert2DAndLen t = Ok ()"
shows "tensor_inv t"
proof -
obtain r c where D: "dims t = [r,c]" and L: "length (data t) = r * c"
using assms unfolding assert2DAndLen_def by (cases "dims t") auto
have "is2D t"
unfolding is2D_def D by simp
moreover have "len_ok t"
unfolding len_ok_def rows_def cols_def D using L by simp
ultimately show ?thesis
unfolding tensor_inv_def by simp
qed

lemma idx_lt_len:
assumes "tensor_inv t"
assumes "i < rows t"
assumes "j < cols t"
shows "idx t i j < length (data t)"
proof -
obtain r c where D: "dims t = [r,c]" and L: "length (data t) = r * c"
using assms(1) unfolding tensor_inv_def is2D_def len_ok_def rows_def cols_def
by (cases "dims t") auto
have R: "rows t = r"
unfolding rows_def D by simp
have C: "cols t = c"
unfolding cols_def D by simp
have I: "i < r"
using assms(2) unfolding R by simp
have J: "j < c"
using assms(3) unfolding C by simp
have "idx t i j = i * c + j"
unfolding idx_def C by simp
moreover have "i * c + j < r * c"
proof -
have A: "i * c + j < i * c + c"
using J by simp
have B: "i * c + c = (i + 1) * c"
by (simp add: algebra_simps)
have C1: "(i + 1) * c ≤ r * c"
proof -
have "i + 1 ≤ r"
using I by simp
thus ?thesis
by (simp add: mult_le_mono_right)
qed
have "i * c + j < (i + 1) * c"
using A B by simp
thus ?thesis
using C1 by (meson lt_le_trans)
qed
ultimately show ?thesis
unfolding L by simp
qed

fun chunk :: "nat ⇒ 'a list ⇒ 'a list list" where
"chunk 0 xs = []" |
"chunk (Suc n) [] = []" |
"chunk (Suc n) xs = take (Suc n) xs # chunk (Suc n) (drop (Suc n) xs)"

lemma concat_chunk_imp:
"n > 0 ⟶ concat (chunk n xs) = xs"
by (induction n xs rule: chunk.induct) simp_all

lemma concat_chunk:
assumes "n > 0"
shows "concat (chunk n xs) = xs"
using concat_chunk_imp[of n xs] assms by simp

lemma chunk_length_mult:
assumes "n > 0"
assumes "length xs = m * n"
shows "length (chunk n xs) = m"
using assms
proof (induction m arbitrary: xs)
case 0
then have "xs = []" by simp
then show ?case using 0 by (cases n) auto
next
case (Suc m)
obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"
using Suc.prems(1) by (cases n) auto
have DropLen: "length (drop n xs) = m * n"
using Suc.prems(2) N by simp
have IH: "length (chunk n (drop n xs)) = m"
using Suc.IH Suc.prems(1) DropLen by simp
have "chunk n xs = take n xs # chunk n (drop n xs)"
using N by (cases xs) auto
then have "length (chunk n xs) = Suc (length (chunk n (drop n xs)))"
by simp
then show ?case
using IH by simp
qed

lemma chunk_set_length:
assumes "n > 0"
assumes "length xs = m * n"
shows "∀ys∈set (chunk n xs). length ys = n"
using assms
proof (induction m arbitrary: xs)
case 0
then have "xs = []" by simp
then show ?case by (cases n) auto
next
case (Suc m)
obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"
using Suc.prems(1) by (cases n) auto
have Len_ge: "n ≤ length xs"
using Suc.prems(2) Suc.prems(1) by simp
have TakeLen: "length (take n xs) = n"
using Len_ge by simp
have DropLen: "length (drop n xs) = m * n"
using Suc.prems(2) N by simp
have IH: "∀ys∈set (chunk n (drop n xs)). length ys = n"
using Suc.IH Suc.prems(1) DropLen by simp
have "chunk n xs = take n xs # chunk n (drop n xs)"
using N by (cases xs) auto
then show ?case
using IH TakeLen by simp
qed

lemma map2_map_map:
"map2 f (map g xs) (map h xs) = map (λx. f (g x) (h x)) xs"
by (induction xs) simp_all

lemma chunk_concat_rect:
assumes "n > 0"
assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = n"
shows "chunk n (concat xss) = xss"
using assms
proof (induction xss)
case Nil
then show ?case by simp
next
case (Cons y ys)
have Ly: "length y = n"
using Cons.prems(2) by simp
have All: "∀ys∈set ys. length ys = n"
using Cons.prems(2) by simp
obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"
using Cons.prems(1) by (cases n) auto
have "chunk n (concat (y # ys)) = chunk n (y @ concat ys)"
by simp
also have "... = take n (y @ concat ys) # chunk n (drop n (y @ concat ys))"
using N by simp
also have "... = y # chunk n (concat ys)"
proof -
have "take n (y @ concat ys) = y"
using Ly by (simp add: take_append)
moreover have "drop n (y @ concat ys) = concat ys"
using Ly by (simp add: drop_append)
ultimately show ?thesis by simp
qed
also have "... = y # ys"
using Cons.IH[OF Cons.prems(1) All] by simp
finally show ?case by simp
qed

lemma length_concat_map_take_rect:
assumes "∀ys∈set rs. length ys = dim * 2"
shows "length (concat (map (take dim) rs)) = length rs * dim"
using assms
proof (induction rs)
case Nil
then show ?case by simp
next
case (Cons y ys)
have Ly: "length y = dim * 2"
using Cons.prems by simp
have All: "∀z∈set ys. length z = dim * 2"
using Cons.prems by simp
have Len_take: "length (take dim y) = dim"
using Ly by simp
have IH: "length (concat (map (take dim) ys)) = length ys * dim"
using Cons.IH[OF All] by simp
show ?case
by (simp add: Len_take IH)
qed

lemma length_concat_map_drop_rect:
assumes "∀ys∈set rs. length ys = dim * 2"
shows "length (concat (map (drop dim) rs)) = length rs * dim"
using assms
proof (induction rs)
case Nil
then show ?case by simp
next
case (Cons y ys)
have Ly: "length y = dim * 2"
using Cons.prems by simp
have All: "∀z∈set ys. length z = dim * 2"
using Cons.prems by simp
have Len_drop: "length (drop dim y) = dim"
using Ly by simp
have IH: "length (concat (map (drop dim) ys)) = length ys * dim"
using Cons.IH[OF All] by simp
show ?case
by (simp add: Len_drop IH)
qed

definition transpose_data :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 list ⇒ f32 list" where
"transpose_data r c xs =
concat (map (λj. map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r]) [0..<c])"

lemma length_transpose_data:
assumes "length xs = r * c"
shows "length (transpose_data r c xs) = r * c"
proof -
have "length (transpose_data r c xs) = c * r"
unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
thus ?thesis
by (simp add: mult.commute)
qed

lemma concat_nth_fixed:
assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = r"
assumes "j < length xss"
assumes "i < r"
shows "concat xss ! (j * r + i) = xss ! j ! i"
using assms
proof (induction xss arbitrary: j)
case Nil
then show ?case by simp
next
case (Cons y ys)
then have Ly: "length y = r"
by simp
show ?case
proof (cases j)
case 0
have "concat (y # ys) ! (0 * r + i) = (y @ concat ys) ! i"
by simp
also have "... = y ! i"
using Cons.prems(3) Ly by (simp add: nth_append)
also have "... = (y # ys) ! 0 ! i"
by simp
finally show ?thesis
using 0 by simp
next
case (Suc j')
have J': "j' < length ys"
using Cons.prems(2) Suc by simp
have All: "∀zs∈set ys. length zs = r"
using Cons.prems(1) by simp
have "concat (y # ys) ! (Suc j' * r + i) = (y @ concat ys) ! (length y + (j' * r + i))"
by simp
also have "... = concat ys ! (j' * r + i)"
using Ly by (simp add: nth_append)
also have "... = ys ! j' ! i"
using Cons.IH[OF All J' Cons.prems(3)] by simp
also have "... = (y # ys) ! Suc j' ! i"
by simp
finally show ?thesis
using Suc by simp
qed
qed

lemma transpose_data_nth:
assumes "j < c"
assumes "i < r"
assumes "length xs = r * c"
shows "transpose_data r c xs ! (j * r + i) = xs ! (i * c + j)"
proof -
let ?xss = "map (λj. map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r]) [0..<c]"
have L1: "∀ys∈set ?xss. length ys = r"
by simp
have J: "j < length ?xss"
using assms(1) by simp
have I: "i < r"
using assms(2) by simp
have "transpose_data r c xs ! (j * r + i) = concat ?xss ! (j * r + i)"
unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
also have "... = ?xss ! j ! i"
using concat_nth_fixed[OF L1 J I] by simp
also have "... = map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r] ! i"
using assms(1) by simp
also have "... = xs ! (i * c + j)"
using assms(2) by simp
finally show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma transpose_data_involutive:
assumes "length xs = r * c"
shows "transpose_data c r (transpose_data r c xs) = xs"
proof (cases c)
case 0
then have "r * c = 0" by simp
then have "length xs = 0" using assms by simp
then have "xs = []" by simp
then show ?thesis
using 0 unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
next
case (Suc c')
let ?ys = "transpose_data r c xs"
have Ly: "length ?ys = r * c"
using length_transpose_data[OF assms] by simp
have Len: "length (transpose_data c r ?ys) = length xs"
using length_transpose_data[of ?ys c r] Ly assms by (simp add: mult.commute)
have Nth: "∀k < length xs. transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = xs ! k"
proof
fix k
assume K: "k < length xs"
have K': "k < r * c"
using K assms by simp
have Cpos: "c > 0"
using Suc by simp
define j where "j = k div c"
define i where "i = k mod c"
have k_eq: "k = j * c + i"
unfolding j_def i_def by (simp add: div_mult_mod_eq)
have i_lt: "i < c"
unfolding i_def using Cpos by (simp add: mod_less_divisor)
have j_lt: "j < r"
unfolding j_def using K' Cpos by (simp add: div_lt_upper_bound)
have "transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = transpose_data c r ?ys ! (j * c + i)"
using k_eq by simp
also have "... = ?ys ! (i * r + j)"
using transpose_data_nth[of j r i c ?ys] j_lt i_lt Ly by simp
also have "... = xs ! (j * c + i)"
using transpose_data_nth[of i c j r xs] i_lt j_lt assms by simp
also have "... = xs ! k"
using k_eq by simp
finally show "transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = xs ! k"
by simp
qed
show ?thesis
using nth_equalityI[OF Len Nth] by simp
qed

definition transpose_pure :: "tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"transpose_pure t =
(case dims t of
[r,c] ⇒ if length (data t) = r * c
then Ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈
else Err DataLengthMismatch
| _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

lemma transpose_pure_spec:
assumes "tensor_inv t"
shows "∃u. transpose_pure t = Ok u ∧ tensor_inv u ∧ dims u = [cols t, rows t]"
proof -
obtain r c where D: "dims t = [r,c]" and L: "length (data t) = r * c"
using assms unfolding tensor_inv_def is2D_def len_ok_def rows_def cols_def
by (cases "dims t") auto
have T: "transpose_pure t = Ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
unfolding transpose_pure_def D L by simp
have Inv: "tensor_inv ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
proof -
have "is2D ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
unfolding is2D_def by simp
moreover have "len_ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
unfolding len_ok_def rows_def cols_def using length_transpose_data[OF L] by simp
ultimately show ?thesis
unfolding tensor_inv_def by simp
qed
have Du: "dims ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈ = [cols t, rows t]"
unfolding cols_def rows_def D by simp
show ?thesis
using T Inv Du by blast
qed

definition matmul_pure :: "tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"matmul_pure a b =
(case (dims a, dims b) of
([m,p],[p',n]) ⇒
if p = p' ∧ length (data a) = m * p ∧ length (data b) = p * n
then let
a_rows = chunk p (data a);
b_cols = transpose_data p n (data b);
b_cols_rows = chunk n b_cols;
dot row col = (∑k<length row. f32_mul (row ! k) (col ! k));
result = concat (map (λrow. map (λcol. dot row col) b_cols_rows) a_rows)
in Ok ⦇dims = [m,n], data = result⦈
else Err ShapeMismatch
| _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

lemma length_concat_map:
assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = n"
shows "length (concat xss) = length xss * n"
using assms
proof (induction xss)
case Nil
then show ?case by simp
next
case (Cons y ys)
have "length y = n" using Cons.prems by simp
moreover have "length (concat ys) = length ys * n" using Cons.IH Cons.prems by simp
ultimately show ?case by simp
qed

lemma matmul_pure_length:
assumes "matmul_pure a b = Ok c"
shows "length (data c) = rows a * cols b"
proof -
obtain m p p' n where Dims: "dims a = [m,p] ∧ dims b = [p',n] ∧ p = p'"
and LenA: "length (data a) = m * p"
and LenB: "length (data b) = p * n"
using assms unfolding matmul_pure_def by (cases "dims a"; cases "dims b") auto
have "length (data c) = m * n"
using assms unfolding matmul_pure_def Dims LenA LenB Let_def
by (auto simp add: length_concat_map)
moreover have "rows a = m ∧ cols b = n"
unfolding rows_def cols_def using Dims by simp
ultimately show ?thesis by simp
qed

definition tensor_add :: "tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"tensor_add a b =
(if dims a = dims b ∧ length (data a) = length (data b)
then Ok ⦇dims = dims a, data = map2 f32_add (data a) (data b)⦈
else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition tensor_sub :: "tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"tensor_sub a b =
(if dims a = dims b ∧ length (data a) = length (data b)
then Ok ⦇dims = dims a, data = map2 f32_sub (data a) (data b)⦈
else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition tensor_div :: "tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"tensor_div a b =
(if dims a = dims b ∧ length (data a) = length (data b)
then Ok ⦇dims = dims a, data = map2 f32_div (data a) (data b)⦈
else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition tensor_clip :: "tensor_pure ⇒ real ⇒ real ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"tensor_clip t lo hi =
(if lo < hi
then Ok ⦇dims = dims t, data = map (f32_clip lo hi) (data t)⦈
else Err InvalidConfig)"

definition tensor_exp :: "tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"tensor_exp t =
(let exp_data = map f32_exp (data t) in
if list_all isFinite_f32 exp_data
then Ok ⦇dims = dims t, data = exp_data⦈
else Err NumericFailure)"

definition tensor_copy :: "tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure" where
"tensor_copy t = ⦇dims = dims t, data = data t⦈"

definition tensor_zeros :: "nat list ⇒ tensor_pure" where

definition clampFiniteInPlace_pure :: "tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure" where

lemma idx_lt_len:
assumes "tensor_inv t"
assumes "i < rows t"
assumes "j < cols t"
shows "idx t i j < length (data t)"
proof -

using assms(1) unfolding tensor_inv_def is2D_def len_ok_def rows_def cols_def
by (cases "dims t") auto

unfolding rows_def D by simp
have C: "cols t = c"
unfolding cols_def D by simp
have I: "i < r"
using assms(2) unfolding R by simp
have J: "j < c"

unfolding idx_def C by simp
moreover have "i * c + j < r * c"
proof -

thus ?thesis
by (simp add: mult_le_mono_right)

qed

qed

fun chunk :: "nat ⇒ 'a list ⇒ 'a list list" where
"chunk 0 xs = []" |
"chunk (Suc n) [] = []" |
"chunk (Suc n) xs = take (Suc n) xs # chunk (Suc n) (drop (Suc n) xs)"

lemma concat_chunk_imp:
"n > 0 ⟶ concat (chunk n xs) = xs"
by (induction n xs rule: chunk.induct) simp_all

lemma concat_chunk:
assumes "n > 0"
shows "concat (chunk n xs) = xs"
using concat_chunk_imp[of n xs] assms by simp

lemma chunk_length_mult:
assumes "n > 0"
assumes "length xs = m * n"
shows "length (chunk n xs) = m"
using assms
proof (induction m arbitrary: xs)
case 0
then have "xs = []" by simp
then show ?case using 0 by (cases n) auto
next
case (Suc m)
obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"
using Suc.prems(1) by (cases n) auto
have DropLen: "length (drop n xs) = m * n"
using Suc.prems(2) N by simp
have IH: "length (chunk n (drop n xs)) = m"
using Suc.IH Suc.prems(1) DropLen by simp
have "chunk n xs = take n xs # chunk n (drop n xs)"
using N by (cases xs) auto
then have "length (chunk n xs) = Suc (length (chunk n (drop n xs)))"
by simp
then show ?case
using IH by simp
qed

lemma chunk_set_length:
assumes "n > 0"
assumes "length xs = m * n"

proof (induction m arbitrary: xs)
case 0

then show ?case by (cases n) auto
next
case (Suc m)
obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"
using Suc.prems(1) by (cases n) auto

using Suc.prems(2) Suc.prems(1) by simp
have TakeLen: "length (take n xs) = n"
using Len_ge by simp
have DropLen: "length (drop n xs) = m * n"
using Suc.prems(2) N by simp
have IH: "∀ys∈set (chunk n (drop n xs)). length ys = n"
using Suc.IH Suc.prems(1) DropLen by simp
have "chunk n xs = take n xs # chunk n (drop n xs)"
using N by (cases xs) auto
then show ?case
using IH TakeLen by simp
qed

lemma map2_map_map:
"map2 f (map g xs) (map h xs) = map (λx. f (g x) (h x)) xs"
by (induction xs) simp_all

lemma chunk_concat_rect:
assumes "n > 0"
assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = n"
shows "chunk n (concat xss) = xss"

proof (induction xss)

then show ?case by simp
next
case (Cons y ys)

using Cons.prems(2) by simp
have All: "∀ys∈set ys. length ys = n"
using Cons.prems(2) by simp
obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"

have "chunk n (concat (y # ys)) = chunk n (y @ concat ys)"
by simp
also have "... = take n (y @ concat ys) # chunk n (drop n (y @ concat ys))"
using N by simp
also have "... = y # chunk n (concat ys)"
proof -

using Ly by (simp add: take_append)
moreover have "drop n (y @ concat ys) = concat ys"

qed

qed

definition transpose_data :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 list ⇒ f32 list" where
"transpose_data r c xs =
concat (map (λj. map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r]) [0..<c])"

lemma length_transpose_data:
assumes "length xs = r * c"
shows "length (transpose_data r c xs) = r * c"
proof -
have "length (transpose_data r c xs) = c * r"
unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
thus ?thesis
by (simp add: mult.commute)
qed

lemma concat_nth_fixed:
assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = r"
assumes "j < length xss"
assumes "i < r"
shows "concat xss ! (j * r + i) = xss ! j ! i"
using assms
proof (induction xss arbitrary: j)
case Nil
then show ?case by simp
next
case (Cons y ys)
then have Ly: "length y = r"
by simp
show ?case
proof (cases j)
case 0
have "concat (y # ys) ! (0 * r + i) = (y @ concat ys) ! i"
by simp
also have "... = y ! i"
using Cons.prems(3) Ly by (simp add: nth_append)
also have "... = (y # ys) ! 0 ! i"
by simp
finally show ?thesis
using 0 by simp
next
case (Suc j')
have J': "j' < length ys"
using Cons.prems(2) Suc by simp
have All: "∀zs∈set ys. length zs = r"
using Cons.prems(1) by simp
have "concat (y # ys) ! (Suc j' * r + i) = (y @ concat ys) ! (length y + (j' * r + i))"
by simp
also have "... = concat ys ! (j' * r + i)"
using Ly by (simp add: nth_append)
also have "... = ys ! j' ! i"
using Cons.IH[OF All J' Cons.prems(3)] by simp
also have "... = (y # ys) ! Suc j' ! i"
by simp
finally show ?thesis
using Suc by simp
qed
qed

lemma transpose_data_nth:
assumes "j < c"
assumes "i < r"
assumes "length xs = r * c"
shows "transpose_data r c xs ! (j * r + i) = xs ! (i * c + j)"
proof -
let ?xss = "map (λj. map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r]) [0..<c]"
have L1: "∀ys∈set ?xss. length ys = r"
by simp
have J: "j < length ?xss"
using assms(1) by simp
have I: "i < r"
using assms(2) by simp
have "transpose_data r c xs ! (j * r + i) = concat ?xss ! (j * r + i)"
unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
also have "... = ?xss ! j ! i"
using concat_nth_fixed[OF L1 J I] by simp
also have "... = map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r] ! i"
using assms(1) by simp
also have "... = xs ! (i * c + j)"
using assms(2) by simp
finally show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma transpose_data_involutive:
assumes "length xs = r * c"
shows "transpose_data c r (transpose_data r c xs) = xs"
proof (cases c)
case 0
then have "r * c = 0" by simp
then have "length xs = 0" using assms by simp
then have "xs = []" by simp
then show ?thesis
using 0 unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
next
case (Suc c')
let ?ys = "transpose_data r c xs"
have Ly: "length ?ys = r * c"
using length_transpose_data[OF assms] by simp
have Len: "length (transpose_data c r ?ys) = length xs"
using length_transpose_data[of ?ys c r] Ly assms by (simp add: mult.commute)
have Nth: "∀k < length xs. transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = xs ! k"
proof
fix k
assume K: "k < length xs"
have K': "k < r * c"
using K assms by simp
have Cpos: "c > 0"
using Suc by simp
define j where "j = k div c"
define i where "i = k mod c"
have k_eq: "k = j * c + i"
unfolding j_def i_def by (simp add: div_mult_mod_eq)
have i_lt: "i < c"
unfolding i_def using Cpos by (simp add: mod_less_divisor)
have j_lt: "j < r"
unfolding j_def using K' Cpos by (simp add: div_lt_upper_bound)
have "transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = transpose_data c r ?ys ! (j * c + i)"
using k_eq by simp
also have "... = ?ys ! (i * r + j)"
using transpose_data_nth[of j r i c ?ys] j_lt i_lt Ly by simp
also have "... = xs ! (j * c + i)"
using transpose_data_nth[of i c j r xs] i_lt j_lt assms by simp
also have "... = xs ! k"
using k_eq by simp
finally show "transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = xs ! k"
by simp
qed
show ?thesis
using nth_equalityI[OF Len Nth] by simp
qed

definition transpose_pure :: "tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"transpose_pure t =
(case dims t of
[r,c] ⇒ if length (data t) = r * c
then Ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈
else Err DataLengthMismatch
| _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

lemma transpose_pure_spec:
assumes "tensor_inv t"
shows "∃u. transpose_pure t = Ok u ∧ tensor_inv u ∧ dims u = [cols t, rows t]"
proof -
obtain r c where D: "dims t = [r,c]" and L: "length (data t) = r * c"
using assms unfolding tensor_inv_def is2D_def len_ok_def rows_def cols_def
by (cases "dims t") auto
have T: "transpose_pure t = Ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
unfolding transpose_pure_def D L by simp
have Inv: "tensor_inv ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
proof -
have "is2D ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
unfolding is2D_def by simp
moreover have "len_ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
unfolding len_ok_def rows_def cols_def using length_transpose_data[OF L] by simp
ultimately show ?thesis
unfolding tensor_inv_def by simp
qed
have Du: "dims ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈ = [cols t, rows t]"
unfolding cols_def rows_def D by simp
show ?thesis
using T Inv Du by blast
qed

definition matmul_pure :: "tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"matmul_pure a b =
(case (dims a, dims b) of
([m,p],[p',n]) ⇒
if p = p' ∧ length (data a) = m * p ∧ length (data b) = p * n
then let
a_rows = chunk p (data a);
b_cols = transpose_data p n (data b);
b_cols_rows = chunk n b_cols;
dot row col = (∑k<length row. f32_mul (row ! k) (col ! k));
result = concat (map (λrow. map (λcol. dot row col) b_cols_rows) a_rows)
in Ok ⦇dims = [m,n], data = result⦈
else Err ShapeMismatch
| _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = n"

definition split_pure :: "nat ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ ((tensor_pure × tensor_pure),err) result" where
"split_pure dim x =
(case dims x of
[batch,w] ⇒ if w = dim * 2
then if length (data x) = batch * w
then let rs = chunk w (data x);
rs1 = map (take dim) rs;
rs2 = map (drop dim) rs
in Ok ((⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs1⦈),
(⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs2⦈))
else Err DataLengthMismatch
else Err ShapeMismatch
| _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition merge_pure :: "nat ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ tensor_pure ⇒ (tensor_pure,err) result" where
"merge_pure dim x1 x2 =
(case (dims x1, dims x2) of
([batch1,d1],[batch2,d2]) ⇒
if batch1 = batch2 ∧ d1 = dim ∧ d2 = dim ∧ length (data x1) = batch1 * dim ∧ length (data x2) = batch2 * dim
then let rs1 = chunk dim (data x1);
rs2 = chunk dim (data x2);
rs = map2 (@) rs1 rs2
in Ok ⦇dims = [batch1, dim * 2], data = concat rs⦈
else Err ShapeMismatch
| _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

lemma merge_split_pure:
assumes "dim > 0"
assumes "dims x = [batch, dim * 2]"
assumes "tensor_inv x"
shows "∃x1 x2. split_pure dim x = Ok (x1,x2) ∧ merge_pure dim x1 x2 = Ok x"
proof -
have Lx: "length (data x) = batch * (dim * 2)"
using assms(2,3) unfolding tensor_inv_def len_ok_def rows_def cols_def by simp
have Wpos: "dim * 2 > 0"
using assms(1) by simp
define rs where "rs = chunk (dim * 2) (data x)"
define rs1 where "rs1 = map (take dim) rs"
define rs2 where "rs2 = map (drop dim) rs"
define x1 where "x1 = ⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs1⦈"
define x2 where "x2 = ⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs2⦈"
have SP: "split_pure dim x = Ok (x1,x2)"
using assms(2) Lx unfolding split_pure_def rs_def rs1_def rs2_def x1_def x2_def by simp
have Rect: "∀ys∈set rs. length ys = dim * 2"
unfolding rs_def using chunk_set_length[OF Wpos Lx] by simp
have Lrs: "length rs = batch"
unfolding rs_def using chunk_length_mult[OF Wpos Lx] by simp
have Rect1: "∀ys∈set rs1. length ys = dim"
proof
fix ys
assume H: "ys ∈ set rs1"
then obtain z where Z: "z ∈ set rs" and Ys: "ys = take dim z"
unfolding rs1_def by auto
have "length z = dim * 2"
using Rect Z by simp
then have "dim ≤ length z"
by simp
thus "length ys = dim"
unfolding Ys by simp
qed
have Rect2: "∀ys∈set rs2. length ys = dim"
proof
fix ys
assume H: "ys ∈ set rs2"
then obtain z where Z: "z ∈ set rs" and Ys: "ys = drop dim z"
unfolding rs2_def by auto
have "length z = dim * 2"
using Rect Z by simp
thus "length ys = dim"
unfolding Ys by simp
qed
have Len1: "length (data x1) = batch * dim"
unfolding x1_def using length_concat_map_take_rect[OF Rect] Lrs rs1_def by simp
have Len2: "length (data x2) = batch * dim"
unfolding x2_def using length_concat_map_drop_rect[OF Rect] Lrs rs2_def by simp
have Chunk1: "chunk dim (data x1) = rs1"
unfolding x1_def using chunk_concat_rect[OF assms(1) Rect1] by simp
have Chunk2: "chunk dim (data x2) = rs2"
unfolding x2_def using chunk_concat_rect[OF assms(1) Rect2] by simp
have MergeForm: "merge_pure dim x1 x2 = Ok ⦇dims = [batch, dim * 2], data = concat (map2 (@) (chunk dim (data x1)) (chunk dim (data x2)))⦈"
unfolding merge_pure_def x1_def x2_def Len1 Len2 by simp
have DataEq: "concat (map2 (@) (chunk dim (data x1)) (chunk dim (data x2))) = data x"
proof -
have "concat (map2 (@) (chunk dim (data x1)) (chunk dim (data x2))) = concat (map2 (@) rs1 rs2)"
using Chunk1 Chunk2 by simp
also have "... = concat (map (λz. take dim z @ drop dim z) rs)"
unfolding rs1_def rs2_def using map2_map_map[of "(@)" "take dim" rs "drop dim"] by simp
also have "... = concat rs"
by simp
also have "... = data x"
unfolding rs_def using concat_chunk[OF Wpos] by simp
finally show ?thesis by simp
qed
have Xeq: "⦇dims = [batch, dim * 2], data = data x⦈ = x"
using assms(2) by (cases x) simp
have Merge: "merge_pure dim x1 x2 = Ok x"
using MergeForm DataEq Xeq by simp
show ?thesis
using SP Merge by blast
qed

  shows "∀ys∈set (chunk n xs). length ys = n"
using assms
proof (induction m arbitrary: xs)
  case 0
  then have "xs = []" by simp
  then show ?case by (cases n) auto
next
  case (Suc m)
  obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"
    using Suc.prems(1) by (cases n) auto
  have Len_ge: "n ≤ length xs"
    using Suc.prems(2) Suc.prems(1) by simp
  have TakeLen: "length (take n xs) = n"
    using Len_ge by simp
  have DropLen: "length (drop n xs) = m * n"
    using Suc.prems(2) N by simp
  have IH: "∀ys∈set (chunk n (drop n xs)). length ys = n"
    using Suc.IH Suc.prems(1) DropLen by simp
  have "chunk n xs = take n xs # chunk n (drop n xs)"
    using N by (cases xs) auto
  then show ?case
    using IH TakeLen by simp
qed

lemma map2_map_map:
  "map2 f (map g xs) (map h xs) = map (λx. f (g x) (h x)) xs"
by (induction xs) simp_all

lemma chunk_concat_rect:
  assumes "n > 0"
  assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = n"
  shows "chunk n (concat xss) = xss"
using assms
proof (induction xss)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  have Ly: "length y = n"
    using Cons.prems(2) by simp
  have All: "∀ys∈set ys. length ys = n"
    using Cons.prems(2) by simp
  obtain n' where N: "n = Suc n'"
    using Cons.prems(1) by (cases n) auto
  have "chunk n (concat (y # ys)) = chunk n (y @ concat ys)"
    by simp
  also have "... = take n (y @ concat ys) # chunk n (drop n (y @ concat ys))"
    using N by simp
  also have "... = y # chunk n (concat ys)"
  proof -
    have "take n (y @ concat ys) = y"
      using Ly by (simp add: take_append)
    moreover have "drop n (y @ concat ys) = concat ys"
      using Ly by (simp add: drop_append)
    ultimately show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  also have "... = y # ys"
    using Cons.IH[OF Cons.prems(1) All] by simp
  finally show ?case by simp
qed

definition transpose_data :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 list ⇒ f32 list" where
"transpose_data r c xs =
  concat (map (λj. map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r]) [0..<c])"

lemma length_transpose_data:
  assumes "length xs = r * c"
  shows "length (transpose_data r c xs) = r * c"
proof -
  have "length (transpose_data r c xs) = c * r"
    unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
  thus ?thesis
    by (simp add: mult.commute)
qed

lemma concat_nth_fixed:
  assumes "∀ys∈set xss. length ys = r"
  assumes "j < length xss"
  assumes "i < r"
  shows "concat xss ! (j * r + i) = xss ! j ! i"
using assms
proof (induction xss arbitrary: j)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  then have Ly: "length y = r"
    by simp
  show ?case
  proof (cases j)
    case 0
    have "concat (y # ys) ! (0 * r + i) = (y @ concat ys) ! i"
      by simp
    also have "... = y ! i"
      using Cons.prems(3) Ly by (simp add: nth_append)
    also have "... = (y # ys) ! 0 ! i"
      by simp
    finally show ?thesis
      using 0 by simp
  next
    case (Suc j')
    have J': "j' < length ys"
      using Cons.prems(2) Suc by simp
    have All: "∀zs∈set ys. length zs = r"
      using Cons.prems(1) by simp
    have "concat (y # ys) ! (Suc j' * r + i) = (y @ concat ys) ! (length y + (j' * r + i))"
      by simp
    also have "... = concat ys ! (j' * r + i)"
      using Ly by (simp add: nth_append)
    also have "... = ys ! j' ! i"
      using Cons.IH[OF All J' Cons.prems(3)] by simp
    also have "... = (y # ys) ! Suc j' ! i"
      by simp
    finally show ?thesis
      using Suc by simp
  qed
qed

lemma transpose_data_nth:
  assumes "j < c"
  assumes "i < r"
  assumes "length xs = r * c"
  shows "transpose_data r c xs ! (j * r + i) = xs ! (i * c + j)"
proof -
  let ?xss = "map (λj. map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r]) [0..<c]"
  have L1: "∀ys∈set ?xss. length ys = r"
    by simp
  have J: "j < length ?xss"
    using assms(1) by simp
  have I: "i < r"
    using assms(2) by simp
  have "transpose_data r c xs ! (j * r + i) = concat ?xss ! (j * r + i)"
    unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
  also have "... = ?xss ! j ! i"
    using concat_nth_fixed[OF L1 J I] by simp
  also have "... = map (λi. xs ! (i * c + j)) [0..<r] ! i"
    using assms(1) by simp
  also have "... = xs ! (i * c + j)"
    using assms(2) by simp
  finally show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma transpose_data_involutive:
  assumes "length xs = r * c"
  shows "transpose_data c r (transpose_data r c xs) = xs"
proof (cases c)
  case 0
  then have "r * c = 0" by simp
  then have "length xs = 0" using assms by simp
  then have "xs = []" by simp
  then show ?thesis
    using 0 unfolding transpose_data_def by simp
next
  case (Suc c')
  let ?ys = "transpose_data r c xs"
  have Ly: "length ?ys = r * c"
    using length_transpose_data[OF assms] by simp
  have Len: "length (transpose_data c r ?ys) = length xs"
    using length_transpose_data[of ?ys c r] Ly assms by (simp add: mult.commute)
  have Nth: "∀k < length xs. transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = xs ! k"
  proof
    fix k
    assume K: "k < length xs"
    have K': "k < r * c"
      using K assms by simp
    have Cpos: "c > 0"
      using Suc by simp
    define j where "j = k div c"
    define i where "i = k mod c"
    have k_eq: "k = j * c + i"
      unfolding j_def i_def by (simp add: div_mult_mod_eq)
    have i_lt: "i < c"
      unfolding i_def using Cpos by (simp add: mod_less_divisor)
    have j_lt: "j < r"
      unfolding j_def using K' Cpos by (simp add: div_lt_upper_bound)
    have "transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = transpose_data c r ?ys ! (j * c + i)"
      using k_eq by simp
    also have "... = ?ys ! (i * r + j)"
      using transpose_data_nth[of j r i c ?ys] j_lt i_lt Ly by simp
    also have "... = xs ! (j * c + i)"
      using transpose_data_nth[of i c j r xs] i_lt j_lt assms by simp
    also have "... = xs ! k"
      using k_eq by simp
    finally show "transpose_data c r ?ys ! k = xs ! k"
      by simp
  qed
  show ?thesis
    using nth_equalityI[OF Len Nth] by simp
qed

definition transpose :: "tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"transpose t =
  (case dims t of
     [r,c] ⇒ if length (data t) = r * c
              then Ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈
              else Err DataLengthMismatch
   | _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

lemma transpose_spec:
  assumes "tensor_inv t"
  shows "∃u. transpose t = Ok u ∧ tensor_inv u ∧ dims u = [cols t, rows t]"
proof -
  obtain r c where D: "dims t = [r,c]" and L: "length (data t) = r * c"
    using assms unfolding tensor_inv_def is2D_def len_ok_def rows_def cols_def
    by (cases "dims t") auto
  have T: "transpose t = Ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
    unfolding transpose_def D L by simp
  have Inv: "tensor_inv ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
  proof -
    have "is2D ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
      unfolding is2D_def by simp
    moreover have "len_ok ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈"
      unfolding len_ok_def rows_def cols_def using length_transpose_data[OF L] by simp
    ultimately show ?thesis
      unfolding tensor_inv_def by simp
  qed
  have Du: "dims ⦇dims = [c,r], data = transpose_data r c (data t)⦈ = [cols t, rows t]"
    unfolding cols_def rows_def D by simp
  show ?thesis
    using T Inv Du by blast
qed

definition clampFiniteInPlace :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
"clampFiniteInPlace t = t⦇data := map clampFinite (data t)⦈"

definition tensor_zeros :: "nat list ⇒ tensor" where
"tensor_zeros ds = ⦇dims = ds, data = replicate (fold (*) ds 1) (Fin 0)⦈"

definition tensor_copy :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
"tensor_copy t = ⦇dims = dims t, data = data t⦈"

definition tensor_add :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"tensor_add a b =
  (if dims a = dims b ∧ length (data a) = length (data b)
   then Ok ⦇dims = dims a, data = map2 f32_add (data a) (data b)⦈
   else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition tensor_sub :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"tensor_sub a b =
  (if dims a = dims b ∧ length (data a) = length (data b)
   then Ok ⦇dims = dims a, data = map2 f32_sub (data a) (data b)⦈
   else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition tensor_div :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"tensor_div a b =
  (if dims a = dims b ∧ length (data a) = length (data b)
   then Ok ⦇dims = dims a, data = map2 f32_div (data a) (data b)⦈
   else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition elementwise_mul :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"elementwise_mul a b =
  (if dims a = dims b ∧ length (data a) = length (data b)
   then Ok ⦇dims = dims a, data = map2 f32_mul (data a) (data b)⦈
   else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition tensor_clip :: "tensor ⇒ real ⇒ real ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"tensor_clip t lo hi =
  (if lo < hi
   then Ok ⦇dims = dims t, data = map (f32_clip lo hi) (data t)⦈
   else Err InvalidConfig)"

definition tensor_exp :: "tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"tensor_exp t =
  (let exp_data = map f32_exp (data t) in
   if list_all isFinite exp_data
   then Ok ⦇dims = dims t, data = exp_data⦈
   else Err NumericFailure)"

definition matmul :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"matmul a b =
  (case (dims a, dims b) of
     ([m,p],[p',n]) ⇒
       if p = p' ∧ length (data a) = m * p ∧ length (data b) = p * n
       then let
         a_rows = chunk p (data a);
         b_cols = transpose_data p n (data b);
         b_cols_rows = chunk n b_cols;
         dot = λrow col. sum_list (map2 (λx y. case f32_mul x y of Fin r ⇒ r | _ ⇒ 0) row col);
         result = concat (map (λrow. map (λcol. Fin (dot row col)) b_cols_rows) a_rows)
       in Ok ⦇dims = [m,n], data = result⦈
       else Err ShapeMismatch
   | _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition add_bias :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"add_bias t bias batch dim =
  (if dims bias = [1,dim] ∧ dims t = [batch,dim] ∧ length (data t) = batch * dim ∧ length (data bias) = dim
   then let
     new_data = concat (map (λb. map (λd. f32_add (get t b d) (get bias 0 d)) [0..<dim]) [0..<batch])
   in Ok ⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = new_data⦈
   else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition split :: "nat ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor × tensor,err) result" where
"split dim x =
  (case dims x of
     [batch,w] ⇒ if w = dim * 2
                  then if length (data x) = batch * w
                       then let rs = chunk w (data x);
                                rs1 = map (take dim) rs;
                                rs2 = map (drop dim) rs
                            in Ok ((⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs1⦈),
                                   (⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs2⦈))
                       else Err DataLengthMismatch
                  else Err ShapeMismatch
   | _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition merge :: "nat ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor,err) result" where
"merge dim x1 x2 =
  (case (dims x1, dims x2) of
     ([batch1,d1],[batch2,d2]) ⇒
       if batch1 = batch2 ∧ d1 = dim ∧ d2 = dim ∧ length (data x1) = batch1 * dim ∧ length (data x2) = batch2 * dim
       then let rs1 = chunk dim (data x1);
                rs2 = chunk dim (data x2);
                rs = map2 (@) rs1 rs2
            in Ok ⦇dims = [batch1, dim * 2], data = concat rs⦈
       else Err ShapeMismatch
   | _ ⇒ Err ShapeMismatch)"

lemma length_concat_map_take_rect:
  assumes "∀ys∈set rs. length ys = dim * 2"
  shows "length (concat (map (take dim) rs)) = length rs * dim"
using assms
proof (induction rs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  have Ly: "length y = dim * 2"
    using Cons.prems by simp
  have All: "∀z∈set ys. length z = dim * 2"
    using Cons.prems by simp
  have Len_take: "length (take dim y) = dim"
    using Ly by simp
  have IH: "length (concat (map (take dim) ys)) = length ys * dim"
    using Cons.IH[OF All] by simp
  show ?case
    by (simp add: Len_take IH)
qed

lemma length_concat_map_drop_rect:
  assumes "∀ys∈set rs. length ys = dim * 2"
  shows "length (concat (map (drop dim) rs)) = length rs * dim"
using assms
proof (induction rs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  have Ly: "length y = dim * 2"
    using Cons.prems by simp
  have All: "∀z∈set ys. length z = dim * 2"
    using Cons.prems by simp
  have Len_drop: "length (drop dim y) = dim"
    using Ly by simp
  have IH: "length (concat (map (drop dim) ys)) = length ys * dim"
    using Cons.IH[OF All] by simp
  show ?case
    by (simp add: Len_drop IH)
qed

lemma merge_split:
  assumes "dim > 0"
  assumes "dims x = [batch, dim * 2]"
  assumes "tensor_inv x"
  shows "∃x1 x2. split dim x = Ok (x1,x2) ∧ merge dim x1 x2 = Ok x"
proof -
  have Lx: "length (data x) = batch * (dim * 2)"
    using assms(2,3) unfolding tensor_inv_def len_ok_def rows_def cols_def by simp
  have Wpos: "dim * 2 > 0"
    using assms(1) by simp
  define rs where "rs = chunk (dim * 2) (data x)"
  define rs1 where "rs1 = map (take dim) rs"
  define rs2 where "rs2 = map (drop dim) rs"
  define x1 where "x1 = ⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs1⦈"
  define x2 where "x2 = ⦇dims = [batch,dim], data = concat rs2⦈"
  have SP: "split dim x = Ok (x1,x2)"
    using assms(2) Lx unfolding split_def rs_def rs1_def rs2_def x1_def x2_def by simp
  have Rect: "∀ys∈set rs. length ys = dim * 2"
    unfolding rs_def using chunk_set_length[OF Wpos Lx] by simp
  have Lrs: "length rs = batch"
    unfolding rs_def using chunk_length_mult[OF Wpos Lx] by simp
  have Rect1: "∀ys∈set rs1. length ys = dim"
  proof
    fix ys
    assume H: "ys ∈ set rs1"
    then obtain z where Z: "z ∈ set rs" and Ys: "ys = take dim z"
      unfolding rs1_def by auto
    have "length z = dim * 2"
      using Rect Z by simp
    then have "dim ≤ length z"
      by simp
    thus "length ys = dim"
      unfolding Ys by simp
  qed
  have Rect2: "∀ys∈set rs2. length ys = dim"
  proof
    fix ys
    assume H: "ys ∈ set rs2"
    then obtain z where Z: "z ∈ set rs" and Ys: "ys = drop dim z"
      unfolding rs2_def by auto
    have "length z = dim * 2"
      using Rect Z by simp
    thus "length ys = dim"
      unfolding Ys by simp
  qed
  have Len1: "length (data x1) = batch * dim"
    unfolding x1_def using length_concat_map_take_rect[OF Rect] Lrs rs1_def by simp
  have Len2: "length (data x2) = batch * dim"
    unfolding x2_def using length_concat_map_drop_rect[OF Rect] Lrs rs2_def by simp
  have Chunk1: "chunk dim (data x1) = rs1"
    unfolding x1_def using chunk_concat_rect[OF assms(1) Rect1] by simp
  have Chunk2: "chunk dim (data x2) = rs2"
    unfolding x2_def using chunk_concat_rect[OF assms(1) Rect2] by simp
  have MergeForm: "merge dim x1 x2 = Ok ⦇dims = [batch, dim * 2], data = concat (map2 (@) (chunk dim (data x1)) (chunk dim (data x2)))⦈"
    unfolding merge_def x1_def x2_def Len1 Len2 by simp
  have DataEq: "concat (map2 (@) (chunk dim (data x1)) (chunk dim (data x2))) = data x"
  proof -
    have "concat (map2 (@) (chunk dim (data x1)) (chunk dim (data x2))) = concat (map2 (@) rs1 rs2)"
      using Chunk1 Chunk2 by simp
    also have "... = concat (map (λz. take dim z @ drop dim z) rs)"
      unfolding rs1_def rs2_def using map2_map_map[of "(@)" "take dim" rs "drop dim"] by simp
    also have "... = concat rs"
      by simp
    also have "... = data x"
      unfolding rs_def using concat_chunk[OF Wpos] by simp
    finally show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  have Xeq: "⦇dims = [batch, dim * 2], data = data x⦈ = x"
    using assms(2) by (cases x) simp
  have Merge: "merge dim x1 x2 = Ok x"
    using MergeForm DataEq Xeq by simp
  show ?thesis
    using SP Merge by blast
qed

record rsf_layer_config =
  clip_min :: real
  clip_max :: real
  seed_offset :: nat
  grad_mean :: bool

record rsf_layer =
  s_weight :: tensor
  t_weight :: tensor
  s_bias :: tensor
  t_bias :: tensor
  s_weight_grad :: tensor
  t_weight_grad :: tensor
  s_bias_grad :: tensor
  t_bias_grad :: tensor
  dim :: nat
  cfg :: rsf_layer_config

definition xavier_init :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ real" where
"xavier_init fan_in fan_out = sqrt (6 / (real fan_in + real fan_out))"

definition randomUniform :: "nat ⇒ real ⇒ real ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 list" where
"randomUniform n lo hi seed = replicate n (Fin 0)"

definition rsf_layer_init :: "nat ⇒ rsf_layer_config ⇒ (rsf_layer,err) result" where
"rsf_layer_init dim cfg =
  (if dim = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
   else if ¬(clip_min cfg < clip_max cfg) then Err InvalidConfig
   else let bound = xavier_init dim dim;
            s_w = ⦇dims = [dim,dim], data = randomUniform (dim*dim) (-bound) bound (42 + seed_offset cfg)⦈;
            t_w = ⦇dims = [dim,dim], data = randomUniform (dim*dim) (-bound) bound (43 + seed_offset cfg)⦈;
            s_b = ⦇dims = [1,dim], data = replicate dim (Fin 0)⦈;
            t_b = ⦇dims = [1,dim], data = replicate dim (Fin 0)⦈;
            z = ⦇dims = [dim,dim], data = replicate (dim*dim) (Fin 0)⦈;
            z_b = ⦇dims = [1,dim], data = replicate dim (Fin 0)⦈
        in Ok ⦇s_weight = s_w, t_weight = t_w, s_bias = s_b, t_bias = t_b,
               s_weight_grad = z, t_weight_grad = z,
               s_bias_grad = z_b, t_bias_grad = z_b,
               dim = dim, cfg = cfg⦈)"

definition zeroGradients :: "rsf_layer ⇒ rsf_layer" where
"zeroGradients layer = layer⦇
  s_weight_grad := (s_weight_grad layer)⦇data := replicate (dim layer * dim layer) (Fin 0)⦈,
  t_weight_grad := (t_weight_grad layer)⦇data := replicate (dim layer * dim layer) (Fin 0)⦈,
  s_bias_grad := (s_bias_grad layer)⦇data := replicate (dim layer) (Fin 0)⦈,
  t_bias_grad := (t_bias_grad layer)⦇data := replicate (dim layer) (Fin 0)⦈
⦈"

definition assertPair :: "rsf_layer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (nat,err) result" where
"assertPair layer a b =
  (case assert2DAndLen a of
     Err e ⇒ Err e
   | Ok _ ⇒
     (case assert2DAndLen b of
        Err e ⇒ Err e
      | Ok _ ⇒
        (if cols a ≠ dim layer ∨ cols b ≠ dim layer then Err ShapeMismatch
         else if rows a ≠ rows b then Err ShapeMismatch
         else if length (data (s_bias layer)) ≠ dim layer ∨ length (data (t_bias layer)) ≠ dim layer then Err ShapeMismatch
         else if ¬(clip_min (cfg layer) < clip_max (cfg layer)) then Err InvalidConfig
         else Ok (rows a))))"

definition rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor × tensor,err) result" where
"rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2 =
  (case assertPair layer x1 x2 of
     Err e ⇒ Err e
   | Ok batch ⇒
     (case transpose x2 of
        Err e ⇒ Err e
      | Ok x2_t ⇒
        (case matmul (s_weight layer) x2_t of
           Err e ⇒ Err e
         | Ok s_x2_t ⇒
           (case transpose s_x2_t of
              Err e ⇒ Err e
            | Ok s_x2_raw ⇒
              (case add_bias s_x2_raw (s_bias layer) batch (dim layer) of
                 Err e ⇒ Err e
               | Ok s_x2_biased ⇒
                 let s_x2_clamped = clampFiniteInPlace s_x2_biased in
                 (case tensor_clip s_x2_clamped (clip_min (cfg layer)) (clip_max (cfg layer)) of
                    Err e ⇒ Err e
                  | Ok s_x2_clipped ⇒
                    let s_x2_clamped2 = clampFiniteInPlace s_x2_clipped in
                    (case tensor_exp s_x2_clamped2 of
                       Err e ⇒ Err e
                     | Ok exp_s ⇒
                       let exp_s_clamped = clampFiniteInPlace exp_s in
                       (case elementwise_mul x1 exp_s_clamped of
                          Err e ⇒ Err e
                        | Ok x1_new ⇒
                          (case transpose x1_new of
                             Err e ⇒ Err e
                           | Ok x1_t ⇒
                             (case matmul (t_weight layer) x1_t of
                                Err e ⇒ Err e
                              | Ok t_x1_t ⇒
                                (case transpose t_x1_t of
                                   Err e ⇒ Err e
                                 | Ok t_x1_raw ⇒
                                   (case add_bias t_x1_raw (t_bias layer) batch (dim layer) of

"isFinite_f32 w = (let e = slice 23 w :: 8 word; m = slice 0 w :: 23 word in e ≠ 0xFF)"

"isInf_f32 w = (let e = slice 23 w :: 8 word; m = slice 0 w :: 23 word in e = 0xFF ∧ m = 0)"

let sign = if s then -1 else 1; exp = (if e = 0 then 1 else uint e) - 127 in

definition real_to_f32 :: "real ⇒ f32" where

let mant = abs_r / (2::real)^exp in
let biased_exp = if exp < -126 then 0 else of_nat (nat (exp + 127)) :: 8 word in
let mantissa = round ((mant - (if exp < -126 then 0 else 1)) * 2^23) :: 23 word in
